_comment: Path-token permission rules merged into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by `hivemind init`. The hardening keys (share, autoshare, autoupdate, server.hostname) and the `bash.sudo *: deny` permission are now baked into the bun-compiled engine via //third_party/patches/{0005,0006}-*.patch — only path-token permissions remain runtime because they need {CACHE_PATH}/{EXPERTS_PATH}/{TEAMS_PATH} substitution against user-specific paths.
